'''2025 Naboo Regionals John Moorley LS profit''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Moorley]] at [[2025 Regional Championships]] (Naboo).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Moorley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Naboo
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:25Naboo Moorley LS Profit.txt |Download]]
